title: Toussaint Louverture
summary: Toussaint Louverture was born enslaved in 1743 on the Bréda plantation in Saint-Domingue and was freed in the 1770s. He rose to command in the revolution that began in 1791, served Spain and then France, and by the late 1790s governed the colony. He was seized in 1802, deported to France, and died at Fort de Joux in 1803.

uncertainty.note: The Collector gives birth as 1743; the EBSCO page opened gives no birth date. Freedom is dated 1776 (The Collector) or 1777 (EBSCO).
